fields.permitted_stay: Up to 14 days, which cannot be extended or converted
fields.application_channel_detail: No visa is needed for stays up to 14 days with a return ticket, confirmed hotel booking, health insurance and sufficient funds. For longer stays apply on the Royal Oman Police eVisa portal before travel.

exceptions: The 14 day visa-free stay cannot be extended or converted. For longer tourism apply for an eVisa before travel
